claim: Methods compared under the same per-user holdout protocol (D-021). This is not globally leakage-safe and not a prediction of future behaviour: models are fitted once and still see other users' ratings and tags dated after a scored user's own cutoff.

provenance.1-10 ratings rung = pure popularity: OWNER DECISION based on validation, not a tuning-grid winner: the tuned SVD/popularity blend tied popularity on NDCG@10 with no clear advantage
provenance.cold-start 0/3/5/10 revealed: OWNER DECISION based on validation: popularity (tied the hybrid at 3 and 5; the hybrid was worse at 10)
provenance.item_knn min_support = 20: tuning-grid winner (validation); owner: keep 20 for comparison, do not search above 20
provenance.svd factors = 50: default kept: no grid value was clearly better (validation)
provenance.warm 10+ hybrid weights: default kept: best alternative inconclusive (validation); owner: keep

routing.0 ratings: genre/popularity mix if genres are given, else popularity
routing.1 to 10 ratings: popularity (cold-start fallback; includes the cold-start simulation at 3, 5 and 10 revealed)
